ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels with a contrast ratio heavily skewed towards the lower end; high-intensity white pixels are limited to localized scars, barnacles, and a specific circular marker, occupying approximately <5% of the total visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment block across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white pixels are mapped to a circular ring in the upper-left quadrant and clustered textured nodes at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch dividing the two lobes, characterized by a sharp convergence point at the center of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular indentations and jagged missing segments; the right lobe shows lower-amplitude, frequent serrations with localized peaks at the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible leading edges rising from the water surface display smooth convex curves tapering toward the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of off-white pixels localized at the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple fine, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions of varying lengths and orientations across the central dark fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large irregular indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe indicating significant tissue loss; a prominent, high-contrast white circular ring mark is located on the upper-inner region of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white ring-shaped mark on the left lobe surface resembling a human-drawn circle or eye-spot.
